description: The in-memory Safetensors replacement branch ignores transpose requests after LinearFP16 transposition moves into the loader.
trigger: Conversion reloads an unquantized linear weight from the in-memory tensor override through Linear.load_fp16 with transpose=True.
expected_behavior: Restore exported output-by-input weights to the input-by-output layout required by LinearFP16, consistently with file-backed loading.
actual_behavior: The override returns the stored orientation unchanged. Source reading predicts a shape error for rectangular weights and wrong calibration products for nonsymmetric square weights; no real conversion path was executed.

introductions.rationale: 119 moves transposition from LinearFP16.__init__ to the loader keyword but leaves the in-memory early return unchanged.

observations.source: Approved fix explanation and reviewer introduction trace.

fixes.rationale: After device transfer, applies .T.contiguous() when transpose is requested before returning an override tensor.

verification.description: 138 approved draft traces export, transpose request and conversion reload; reviewer traces the introduction to119.
verification.limits: No conversion, PyTorch or native execution; which actual layers take this path was not established.

verification.description: 138 draft checks a rectangular transpose round trip and different nonsymmetric square products.
verification.limits: Standard-library matrix arithmetic only; no device transfer or contiguity test.

affected_revisions.limits: Introduction and fix source-supported; no continuous affected range asserted. Unaffected means transpose handling only: float2half and padding gaps are not claimed fixed.
